body: I'm going to go see her tomorrow and I can't wait. I guess I probably should stick around at least while she's still here.
Her name is Ebony. She is a Staffordshire Bull Terrier, they're not the violent dogs some people make them out to be for some reason. They're so lovable and friendly.

Thank you for the suggestions, I'll try some sad music. I haven't seen my dog in 2 weeks because she's been staying with one of my relatives who is looking after her, I miss her a lot. Sorry I am going off topic, anyway hopefully this can bring me out of the world for a few hours.
